project.name: Cube Coach
project.summary: A one-page web app that walks a child through solving a 2x2 or 3x3 Rubik's cube: copy the cube's colors by tapping or with the camera, let the app check them and work out the moves, then follow each turn on an animated 3D cube. It speaks English, Hebrew and Polish and is published on GitHub Pages.

nodes.label: The app
nodes.summary: The pieces of the app, kept as separate files while you work on them and glued into one page for publishing.

nodes.label: Cube brains
nodes.summary: Knows what a real cube looks like: checks a copied cube, repairs a side copied the wrong way round, points at a wrong square, and solves the 2x2 itself.

nodes.label: Color reading
nodes.summary: Turns camera or photo pixels into the six sticker colors and finds the cube in a photo.

nodes.label: Words in three languages
nodes.summary: Every sentence the child reads, in English, Hebrew and Polish, with the rules for plurals and color names.

nodes.label: Screens, 3D cube and camera
nodes.summary: Draws every screen, animates the 3D cube and its arrows, runs the camera sheet, saves progress on the phone and starts the app.

nodes.label: Look and page skeleton
nodes.summary: The colors, fonts and layout for phones in light and dark mode, and the page the pieces are poured into.

nodes.label: Build step
nodes.summary: Glues the pieces in src into the single published page, and can check that the page is up to date.

nodes.label: Published page
nodes.summary: The whole app in one file, generated by the build step and served to phones by GitHub Pages. Never edited by hand.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.summary: Proof that the cube maths, the color reading, every screen in every language and the camera paths keep working.

nodes.label: Quick checks
nodes.summary: Fast checks run before every commit: the cube brains against thousands of random cubes, color reading on real photos, and every word in every language.

nodes.label: Browser tests
nodes.summary: Drives the real page in a phone-sized headless browser: full solves in each language, the camera paths, and a walk over every screen that compares text and height.

nodes.label: 3x3 solver (cubejs)
nodes.summary: An open-source Rubik's cube solver, downloaded from the jsDelivr CDN the first time a 3x3 is picked; the tests keep an offline copy.

nodes.label: Google Fonts
nodes.summary: The two typefaces, Fredoka and Andika, plus Assistant for Hebrew text.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages
nodes.summary: Free hosting that publishes the page at maxfokin.github.io/cube-coach within a minute of every push to main.

files.name: README screenshots

files.name: Build step
files.d: Glues the CSS and JavaScript pieces into index.html in a fixed order, or checks that the page is up to date.
files.doc: Assemble index.html (the whole app, one file) from the pieces in src/.

files.name: Published page
files.d: The whole app in one file, generated from src by the build step and served to phones by GitHub Pages; never edited by hand.
files.note: Generated by build.py from src. Edit the pieces in src, then rebuild; never edit this file by hand.

files.name: Colors, fonts and layout
files.d: Sets the look of every screen: the colors in light and dark mode, the fonts, the 3D stage, grids, buttons and small-phone sizes.

files.name: Camera sheet
files.d: Opens the live camera or a photo, lets the child fit the side in the square, shows the colors it reads, and fills the grid.
files.doc: ===== Copy a side with the camera ===== Live camera when the page may use it; otherwise the phone's own camera through a photo.

files.name: Color reading
files.d: Finds the cube in a photo and judges each sticker's color from its most vivid pixels, marking the doubtful ones.
files.doc: ===== Reading sticker colors from camera pixels ===== px: RGBA bytes (canvas ImageData layout), w x h.

files.name: 2x2 cube brain
files.d: Works out the whole 2x2 from four copied sides, checks it is a real cube, points at a wrong square, and finds the shortest solution.
files.doc: ===== 2x2 cube core: model, deduction from 4 sides, validation, optimal solver ===== Coordinates: x right, y up, z toward the viewer.

files.name: 3x3 cube brain
files.d: Checks a copied 3x3 is a real cube, repairs a side copied the wrong way round, points at a wrong square, and prepares the cube for the solver.
files.doc: ===== 3x3 cube core ===== Facelets in Kociemba order: U, R, F, D, L, B; each face read row by row as seen from outside (U with the back at the top, D with the front at the top, side faces with U at the top).

files.name: Cube picker, switch and camera look
files.d: Styles the cube choice, the language switch under the brand, the 3x3 grids, the thinking spinner and the camera sheet.

files.name: Start-up
files.d: Starts the app: applies the saved language, restores progress, builds the cube, and runs the two-tap Start over button.

files.name: Page skeleton
files.d: The empty page the pieces are poured into: the title, icon and fonts, the header, the 3D stage and the panel.

files.name: Words in three languages
files.d: Holds every sentence in English, Hebrew and Polish, with plural forms and per-color sentences, and picks the right one for the current language.
files.doc: ===== Words, in every language ===== STRINGS[key] = { en, he, pl }.
files.note: The review surface for translations: each key shows its English, Hebrew and Polish together.

files.name: Screens and 3D cube
files.d: Draws every screen, animates the 3D cube and its arrows, saves progress on the phone, and loads the 3x3 solver when it is needed.

files.name: Color reading tests
files.d: Reads a synthetic 3x3 side exactly and the four real photos of the family's cube at least 15 of 16 squares right.
files.doc: Color reading: a synthetic 3x3 side always runs; the four real photos run when present in tests/fixtures/photos (they are personal photos, kept out of git by default).

files.name: 2x2 brain tests
files.d: Checks the known photo cube's 9-turn solution, 200 random cubes, both copy orders, and that a wrong square is always caught.

files.name: 3x3 brain tests
files.d: Checks the turns against the cubejs solver, that every solution solves the cube, that a turned side is fixed, and that a wrong square is caught.

files.name: Camera tests
files.d: Copies sides from the family's real photos, a synthetic 3x3 side and a fake live camera, and checks the colors read right.
files.doc: Browser tests for copying a side from the camera: the photo fallback (real photos when present, otherwise the synthetic side) and a fake live camera.

files.name: Test fixtures
files.d: Makes what the browser tests need: a random 3x3 scramble, a synthetic 3x3 side photo, and a fake camera clip from a real photo.
files.doc: Generates the fixtures the browser tests need: a random 3x3 scramble (as the kid would copy it), a synthetic 3x3 side photo, and a fake live-camera clip from real photo 1 when it exists.

files.name: Solve flow tests
files.d: Solves the known 2x2 in every language and a 3x3 in a phone-sized browser, checking the switch, the theme toggle, the credits line, the phone's language, reloads, Start over and blocked storage.
files.doc: Browser tests for the whole app: a 2x2 solve from the known photo cube in every language the welcome switch offers, and a 3x3 solve from a random scramble.

files.name: Screen walk
files.d: Walks 22 screens in one language, comparing English text with its snapshot, checking no foreign words remain and the credits line is there, and measuring heights.
files.doc: Walks every screen in one language and records its text and page height at 375x667.

files.name: Test loader
files.d: Reads the source pieces straight from src and runs them so the quick checks can call the cube brains, color reading and words.
files.doc: Loads the app's source modules into Node for testing.

files.name: Run all quick checks
files.d: Runs the words, 2x2, 3x3 and color reading checks one after another; this is what npm test calls.
files.doc: Runs the Node tests one after another: `npm test`

files.name: Words tests
files.d: Checks every sentence exists in every language with matching placeholders, well-formed plural and color sets, and no shouting or em dashes.
files.doc: The strings table: every key in every language, matching placeholders, well-formed plural and per-color sets, and t() picking the right variant.

links.desc: The build reads the CSS and JavaScript pieces in src, in a fixed order.

flows.title: Solving a 2x2
flows.description: From copying the colors to the last turn.

steps.note: The child taps the colors of four sides, or copies them from a photo.
Works out the hidden top and bottom from the four sides, checks it is a real cube, and finds the shortest solution.
Shows the deduced top and bottom to confirm, then one animated turn at a time until the confetti.
Six sides are copied, guided by the middle color of each.
Checks the copy is a real cube, repairs a side copied turned around, or points at the one wrong square.
The downloaded solver works out a 20-22 move solution; the app re-plays it on its own model to be sure.
Shows the moves with arrows, including turns of the back layer on the top face.

flows.title: Copying a side with the camera

steps.note: The Photo button opens the camera sheet: live camera, or a photo when the camera is not allowed.
Finds the cube in the picture and judges each sticker's color from its most vivid pixels, marking doubtful ones.
The colors land in the grid; doubtful squares get a dotted outline so the child can check them.

flows.title: From a change to the live site

steps.note: python3 build.py glues the pieces into index.html.
npm test and the browser tests must pass before committing.
index.html is committed together with the sources.
A push to main is live within a minute.

tour.title: One app, many pieces
tour.note: Cube Coach is a single web page for phones. While working on it, it is split into pieces under src: the cube maths, the color reading, the words, the screens and the look.

tour.title: Three languages
tour.note: Every sentence the child sees lives here in English, Hebrew and Polish. Change a word here, never in the screens.

tour.title: The cube brains
tour.note: These check that a copied cube is real, fix a side copied the wrong way round, point at a wrong square, and solve the 2x2 themselves.

tour.title: Help for the 3x3
tour.note: The 3x3 is solved by cubejs, downloaded once from a CDN. That is why the 3x3 needs internet the first time.

tour.title: Screens and the 3D cube
tour.note: The screens, the animated cube with its arrows, and the camera sheet. Progress is saved on the phone, so a reload lands on the same move.

tour.title: The published page
tour.note: The build glues everything into index.html, the file GitHub Pages serves. Never edit it by hand.

tour.title: Safety net
tour.note: Quick checks run before every commit; browser tests drive the real page in every language.

tour.title: Where the screens live
tour.note: If you want to change what a screen shows, this is the file. The words themselves stay in strings.js.
